arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: input
arg.description: The detections of the image, e.g. ~/detections of dnn_object_detection.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the result

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Queue size of the synchronized subscribers of the image and the detections.

arg.name: approximate_sync
arg.description: Synchronize the image and the detections by the approximate time of the stamps, instead of the exact time

arg.name: model
arg.description: Path or URL of the person ReID model (onnx, 128x256 RGB input), empty for the YouTu ReID model of opencv_zoo

arg.name: backend
arg.description: Backend of cv::dnn: auto, cpu, opencl, opencl_fp16, cuda or cuda_fp16. auto uses CUDA when OpenCV is built with CUDA and a CUDA device is found, and the CPU otherwise.

arg.name: label
arg.description: Label of the detections to re-identify, empty for all of them

arg.name: match_threshold
arg.description: Threshold of the cosine similarity to the person seen before to have the same id, a new id otherwise

arg.name: update_rate
arg.description: Rate of the feature of the new image in the moving average of the feature of the person
